svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Ships (4)
svg.desc: Four captains told apart in wood: CRUMBLE plain, BISCOTTI striped, GINGERSNAP dotted, SHORTBREAD checked (pink, teal, green, orange in the app — paint the sails if you like). An old pirate ship after the game's own sailboat art: a 6 mm hull seen from above (24 × 12 mm, deck planks, a tiller) with two slots ACROSS the beam; two 3 mm square sails on their masts — the game's skull over crossed bones on each, the captain's mark along the foot — whose tabs drop through the slots and sit flush underneath. About 30 mm tall. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
